If you're interested in getting a Costco membership, this is the best deal I've seen in quite some time. Head over here to get a Gold Star membership for $65 AND get a $45 Costco shop card. This could definitely come in handy as we head into the holiday season! Check out the details: "Your Groupon shows Redeemed as soon as you buy. That’s normal: your membership starts right away and will expire 12 months from the date you purchased. Step 1 — Purchase Select your Gold Star ($65/year) or Executive ($130/year) membership. You'll receive a confirmation email with your new 12-digit membership number, and after setting up your account, you can shop on Costco.com immediately. Keep this email; you'll need that number to verify your membership. Step 2 — Get Your Physical Membership Card Visit any Costco warehouse with a valid photo ID to get your physical membership card. Your household member can also get their complimentary membership card the same way. A physical card is not required for online shopping or to receive your Digital Costco Shop Card, but you need a physical card or the Costco app to purchase in the warehouses. Step 3 — Create Your Costco.com Account & Verify Membership Go to Costco.com and select Create Account. Enter your email address, send the verification code, and set a password. Use the same email address you used for your Groupon purchase. Then go to Account Details → Costco Wallet, enter your 12-digit membership number, and click Verify Membership. If you're unable to verify your account online, please visit the membership counter at your local Costco warehouse for assistance. Step 4 — Digital Costco Shop Card Delivery Download the Costco app and sign in. Your $45 Digital Costco Shop Card is loaded directly into your Costco Wallet within 2 weeks of successful sign-up. Costco will email you once your funds have been added, and you can check your Costco Wallet anytime in the app. You'll need the app to use your Digital Costco Shop Card in-warehouse; you can also view funds and apply them to online purchases at Costco.com under Account → Costco Wallet.
Important: The $45 Digital Costco Shop Card is available to new members only, or those who haven't held a Costco Membership in the past 18 months. If you already have an active membership, this offer won't apply, and the Digital Costco Shop Card will not be issued. You must create a Costco.com account and verify your membership to receive your Digital Costco Shop Card."

"Endless Summer Fun with Maison Lude Lux Tiles 3-in-1 Summer Pool Set
Brighten your game days with the Maison Lude Lux Tiles 3-in-1 Summer Pool Set. This vibrant set transforms any table into a splash of fun, featuring waterproof cards and a citrus-inspired pool mat. Designed for outdoor play, it combines quality and style for Mahjong enthusiasts and anyone who loves sun-filled laughter and versatile gameplay.
Precision Craftsmanship and Versatile Design
Inside this bundle, you'll find a 160-tile Mahjong set with sample hand cards, a 54-card waterproof deck for classic games, and a 106-tile Rummi set. The set also includes four tile support bars and a premium summer pool mat, offering everything needed to switch between Mahjong, Rummi, or card games. The water-resistant pool mat, is durable, easy to clean, and soft under tiles, ensuring steady gameplay while adding a burst of summer charm.
Easy to Learn, Fun to Master
Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, the Lux Tiles 3-in-1 Summer Pool Set makes learning and switching between games simple and enjoyable. With sample hands and clear rules included, this set is perfect for families, groups of friends, or anyone looking to dive into the fun of tile games.
Bring sunshine and connection to your gatherings with the Maison Lude Lux Tiles 3-in-1 Summer Pool Set. Ideal for family game nights, social events, or as a thoughtful gift, this set redefines tradition with extraordinary style and playability."
If you're new to Mah Jong and looking for a set, head over here for the best deal I've found (also from Sam's Club). The blooming tiles are beautiful, and everything you need to play (besides the Mah Jong card) is included: the bag, the tiles, the racks, the game mat, the tile case, and more! I like it so much I bought three (one for myself, one for my mother, and one for my mother-in-law). This is so much prettier than the basic Amazon sets, and I believe it rivals the exorbitantly expensive sets (this set of tiles is $500 and doesn't include the racks, game mat, case, or bag).
Wildflower Bread Company has square tables perfect for Mah Jong, and you'll almost always see groups of ladies at the Scottsdale location playing. It helps keep the mind fresh and is such a fun excuse to get together with friends often. Studies have shown that good friends (the non-toxic variety) can literally lengthen your life!
Enjoy!

Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
A few months ago, I wrote about how excited I was to receive free tickets to visit The Price Is Right. Kaitlyn and I had a GREAT pre-college mother-daughter trip, and the episode we were on aired yesterday (October 14th)! If you'd like to watch it, head over here to CBS.com (or use their app). Dang I heard so many were watching it they're making people sign up for Paramount+ now. Ugh! You can search for 10/14 Price is Right on Youtube, my sister sent me the links! Email me alicia@dealsinaz.com if you can't find them! It's Season 54, episode 17, in case you find it a different way.
For me personally, it was by far the BEST deal I've posted about! We got free tickets, had a blast, met amazing people, and (spoiler alert) I WON the showcase showdown! It was definitely a bucket list thing that worked out better than I ever could have hoped!
If you would love to “Come on Down” too, head over here to request your free tickets! If you pick Priority tickets, you’re GUARANTEED a seat as long as you’re on time. There are STILL dates available while I’m typing this! You’ll have to get yourself to California for the taping on the date you pick. Once you arrive, you'll wear a number and go in groups to "try out" for the producer, who will choose the contestants. My advice is to bring every bit of energy and enthusiasm you've got into your audition. You may go and not get called (this is probably the most likely outcome), but hopefully you have a great time! No matter what, you'll leave the show a member of the "Price is Right family".
I'm an empty nester (more positively known as a "bird launcher") now, and while I miss the kids A LOT, I'm excited for lots of travels and fun. Trips to Maine, Montreal, and Japan will be GREAT adventures! I think my experience highlights the importance of not going over (I was insanely lucky)!
Update: I have heard from lots of people upset that I did not listen to Kaitlyn and pick the 2, but sadly, I could not see her from where I was standing! I heard after the game was over that she was holding up a 2. Oh well! My mind was not registering having two 2's in the price (probably good to keep in mind if you happen to be chosen for the Any Number game)!
Enjoy if you choose to watch, and good luck if you go! And THANK YOU Drew and all of the amazing people at The Price is Right! What a fun experience!

posts.title: September 6th Get Free Admission to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, the Phoenix Art Museum, and the Heard Museum in the Evening!
posts.excerpt: Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out downtown Phoenix! This Friday, September 6th, three fantastic…
posts.text:
Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out downtown Phoenix! This Friday, September 6th, three fantastic museums will offer everyone free admission at various times.
First on the list is the Children’s Museum of Phoenix! This fun and interactive place is perfect for the little ones in your life. Admission is usually $17/each (adults must pay too), but on Friday, September 6th from 5-9 PM it will be free for everyone. Click here to read what the Children’s Museum of Phoenix wrote about Free Friday capacity limits and recommendations.
Next up is the Phoenix Art Museum. For PhxArt Afterhours they're offering free admission to all from 5-9 PM! They promise live music, art-making workshops, entertainment, and more. Tickets are usually $25 for adults and $18 for kids. There is a charge for the special exhibit, head over here for more information.
Last but certainly not least on the list is the Heard Museum. Check out the very important event they have going on this month:
"Join us this September, the Heard Museum invites you to a special First Friday event in recognition of the National Day of Remembrance for U.S. Indian Boarding Schools. For 24 years, our exhibition Away From Home has shed light on a significant period in American history when Indigenous children were separated from their families to attend government-run boarding schools."
I called to confirm that admission is free for all on 9/6 from 4-8 PM. Admission is usually $22.50 for adults and $9 for kids.
Enjoy!

posts.title: LOVE THIS! Amazon Will Give Your Driver a $5 Bonus if You Say "Alexa, Thank My Driver" to Your Echo Device! No Cost to You!
posts.excerpt: If your Amazon driver has become your most frequent visitor, there's a way to say thank you at no cost to you. Say "Alexa, thank my driver" to your Echo device…
posts.text:
If your Amazon driver has become your most frequent visitor, there's a way to say thank you at no cost to you. Say "Alexa, thank my driver" to your Echo device and they'll receive a $5 bonus (plus they'll be notified that you thanked them).
Customers can say “Alexa, thank my driver,” and the driver of their most recent delivery will be notified of their gratitude.
Check out the details:
"Update: In response to the incredible impact of the celebratory promotion, in which we reached 1 million "thank yous" within 36 hours of launch, we are spreading even more joy, starting December 21. Eligible drivers will be offered $5 per "thank you" for another 1 million "thank yous.”
Since Amazon opened its digital doors in 1994, not only has selection grown, but so has the ability to deliver quickly and conveniently. So much so, that we hit a major package milestone—15 billion Amazon packages delivered in the U.S. But for drivers, it’s more than just the packages that they deliver—they form relationships with customers, provide support to the community in tough moments, and sometimes play the role of the unexpected hero.
We’ve heard many examples through social media, emails, phone calls, and when talking with friends and family. You can even read some of them for yourself. Now, we’ll provide customers with the opportunity to say thanks each and every day—with the help of Alexa. We developed an Alexa feature that allows customers to directly thank their drivers for making their deliveries. This new feature is available to U.S. customers with an Alexa-enabled device (Echo, Echo Show) or the Alexa or Amazon Shopping mobile apps, making it easy to thank drivers in the U.S. anywhere.
Starting December 7, any time a customer says “Alexa, thank my driver,” the driver who delivered their most recent package will be notified of the customer’s appreciation. And, in celebration of this new feature, with each thank-you received from customers, drivers will also receive an additional $5, at no cost to the customer. We’ll be doing this for the first 1 million thank-you’s received. And, the five drivers who receive the most customer “thank-you’s” during the promotional period, will also be rewarded with $10,000 and an additional $10,000 to their charity of choice.
We love hearing the countless stories from customers about the many ways delivery drivers make their lives better. We are excited for this new opportunity to thank these everyday heroes and giving our customers the ability to help us do it.
Amazon has a long-standing commitment to empowering and investing in delivery drivers. While this thank-you is another moment for us to express our gratitude, it certainly will not be the last, and we look forward to finding additional opportunities to celebrate the drivers who deliver smiles for customers.
Thank you, delivery drivers, for helping us deliver for customers this holiday season and every day."
I just thanked my driver!
LOVE THIS!

I have gotten so many e-mails asking for discounts to the Immersive Van Gogh Phoenix Exhibit, and I finally have one! Head over here to pick up a ticket for $25.10 plus fees ($6) on Goldstar. This is usually $50.20! Everyone I've talked to that's been has thought it was INCREDIBLE!
"From creators of the blockbuster exhibit seen by over 2 million people in Paris, and after selling over half a million tickets in Toronto, Chicago, San Francisco and L.A., the Immersive Van Gogh Exhibit is making its mark in Phoenix! Lose yourself in 500,000 cubic feet of monumental projections animating Vincent van Gogh’s oeuvre. Wander through entrancing, moving images that highlight brushstrokes, detail, and color – truly illuminating the mind of the genius. Created by the world-renowned master of digital art, Italy’s Massimiliano Siccardi, who for 30 years has been pioneering immersive exhibitions in Europe, Immersive Van Gogh features stunning towering projections that illuminate the artistic genius’s mind. You will be immersed in Van Gogh’s works, from his sunny landscapes and night scenes to his portraits and still life paintings. The installation includes the Mangeurs de pommes de terre (The Potato Eaters, 1885), the Nuit étoilée (Starry Night, 1889), Les Tournesols (Sunflowers, 1888), and La Chambre à coucher (The Bedroom, 1889), and so much more. Merging state-of-the-art technology, theatrical storytelling, and world-class animation, don’t miss the captivating and breathtaking digital art experience Time Out Chicago calls “the future of experiential art.” The exhibit is designed and conceived by Massimiliano Siccardi, with soundtrack by Luca Longobardi, who both pioneered immersive digital art experiences in France."
Enjoy!

posts.excerpt: If you're thinking about taking the family out this weekend, keep in mind that the Wildlife World Zoo and Aquarium is now open! Head over here to save big on…
posts.text:
If you're thinking about taking the family out this weekend, keep in mind that the Wildlife World Zoo and Aquarium is now open! Head over here to save big on tickets, Groupon has adult tickets on sale for $30.99 (usually $39.99) and child tickets on sale for $16.99 (usually $19.99). Use code SAVE to get 20% off (it will say the code is expired but should give you an extra discount anyway)! The extra 20% off brings kids tickets down to $13.59 and adult tickets down to $24.79. Check out their Covid safety information:
"With the Grand Reopening, there will be several safety measures and operational changes at the Zoo, including required masks for staff and visitors, informative signage throughout the zoo encouraging safety/social distancing, social distance ride seating, along with complete ride sanitation after every rider and dozens of sanitizing stations installed throughout the 100-acres. “We are grateful for the continued support from the public, even while our gates have been closed. It brings me much joy, that the time has come that we can responsibly reopen and provide our guests with a safe environment to bring their loved ones”, says Director Mickey Ollson. The Sky Ride, African Tram, Safari Train, all Indoor Exhibits, the Petting Zoo, the Giraffe Feeding Station & Stingray Touch Tank will be open. Wildlife World’s standards are subject to change based on recommendations from the state and municipal public health officials."
"What You'll Get
What’s included: admission, access to public feedings, and Wildlife Encounter Shows
Child admission is valid for ages 3–12.
Free admission for children aged 2 and under.
Younger than 18 must be accompanied by a guardian.
Onsite cafeteria: yes, there are several cafes located in various areas.
Amenities: gift shops, stroller rental, wheelchair rental
Transportation: free parking available
The Fine Print
Promotional value expires Jan 18, 2021. Amount paid never expires. Not valid until June 5th, 2020. Younger than 18 must be accompanied by guardian. Child ticket is only valid for ages 3-12. Age 2 and under are free. Limit 5 per person, may buy 10 additional as gift(s). Valid only for option purchased. Merchant is solely responsible to purchasers for the care and quality of the advertised goods and services.
About Wildlife World Zoo, Aquarium & Safari Park
The giraffe smells a food pellet. He pokes his head just over the railing and starts sniffing for the guest holding his treat. Not far off, some brightly plumed parrots land on another visitor’s arm, spying the tasty apple slices in her hand. Though you can’t get this close to every animal at Wildlife World Zoo & Aquarium—such as the lions and the wild Larry Fitzgeralds—the keepers do facilitate animal-human exchanges as often as possible with the zoo’s more than 600 species. They also give visitors novel views of some exhibits by welcoming them aboard the Skyride, the Australian boat ride, and the African train safari. The adjacent aquarium adds to the zoo’s impressive animal collection, housing more than 75 exhibits and enough water to start a new earth colony.
Further attractions include a children’s petting zoo, daily shows, and a baby-animal nursery. At the 15-acre Safari Park, guests stroll or ride the tram through animal habitats, where they can spy on species that live on the other side of the equator. Wildlife World also features two restaurants where guests can feed themselves and their own helpless progeny."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Save on Cleaning Products That Work Great and are SO MUCH Better for the Earth!
posts.excerpt: Head over here to score 50% off a starter kit from Truman's! You'll pay $7.50 shipped if you want auto refills or $10 if you want to try it and not be locked…
posts.text:
Head over here to score 50% off a starter kit from Truman's! You'll pay $7.50 shipped if you want auto refills or $10 if you want to try it and not be locked into any other purchases (that's what I did). This is cleaning that is SO much better for the earth (and the products are wonderful).
Check out their story:
"We started Truman's because, while we’re somewhat obsessed with cleaning, we’re totally obsessed with reducing waste and clutter. Nowhere could we have a bigger impact than in the overcrowded world of home cleaning products, where so many specialized cleaners in plastic bottles clamor for our dollars with “fresh new scents” and trendy colors. Nobody needs a gazillion cleaning products with harsh chemicals cluttering their cabinets, and our planet certainly doesn’t need the plastic empties. That’s why we offer just 4 cleaners with refill cartridges — all non-toxic — that safely and effectively clean virtually all of your home's hard surfaces. It's a concept so novel that Fast Company has honored Truman's as a World Changing Idea.
So that's Truman's. Cleaning glass and taking names."
Check out the products:
"EVERYTHING AND THE KITCHEN SINK
There's no use crying over spilled milk. Unless you were thirsty. Then cry.
The perfect combination of brains and brawn, I'm tough on grease but gentle on your surfaces. And just as my name implies, spray me on whatever you want in the kitchen. Except food. I'm non-toxic, but I'm also non-tasty. If you spray me on a food-bearing surface, be sure to rinse it before eating. (Our lawyers made us say that.)
If you're dealing with a really nasty spill or grease buildup, let me sit there a little longer. Really, I don't mind the wait. Whether you have fancy-schmancy marble countertops or a grill that hasn't been scraped since the Cowboys' last Super Bowl, I'm your cleaner. Now smother me with that wash rag and let's do this.
FLOORS TRULY
Floors so clean you SHOULD eat off them.
I care deeply for the surface you touch the most — the floor. Ordinary cleaners can leave streaks or strip the finish off your floors. I won't strip or streak in your home. You're welcome.
My pH-neutral composition makes me the Switzerland of cleaning products and protects the integrity of your surfaces. And did I mention I'm completely non-toxic? Your dog, or your child, or your dog and your child, can roll around in puddles of me without harm. (Though that'd be weird, so it's probably best if they don't.)
Just spray me 6 to 8 inches from your target area, then spread my goodness around with a mop or dry cloth. Watch your floors sparkle like the 4th of July, courtesy of Floors Truly.
MORE SHOWER TO YOU
Maybe we should wait 30 or 45 minutes before we go in there.
Look, nobody likes cleaning a bathroom. I get it. Unspeakable things happen behind closed doors.
But take a deep breath (before entering), because we got this. I'm as non-toxic as your kitchen cleaner but specially formulated to tackle problems unique to bathrooms. I don't just clean bathroom surfaces with soap scum, mineral deposits and water spots, I freaking emulsify them.
While your stuff don't stink, most does. That's why I deodorize while I clean. I'm basically the Justin Timberlake of bathroom cleaning. I can sing and dance, OK?
And once I've done my job, you can go back to reading the paper. Wait, nobody does that anymore? Chalk it up to another pastime ruined by the iPhone.
THE GLASS IS ALWAYS CLEANER
The days of streaking are over. But skinny-dipping is still OK.
Hey good lookin'. Why don't you spritz a little bit of me on the mirror and brush your teeth with a view? Yeah, that's better.
When you're done checking yourself out, take me to the windows and...televisions? That's right, I'm safe for use on TV screens and computer monitors, even cell phones and tablets. Just spray me onto a cloth first and then wipe gently. Fun fact: your phone is probably dirtier than your toilet. Swipe left for E. coli.
I'm ammonia free, streak free, toxin free, pretty much...free. Well, not totally. You still have to pay for me. "
We should all be as ecologically friendly as possible, and these products are a small way to help (plus I'm really excited about them)!
Enjoy!

Head over here to get $30 to spend at Dillon's BBQ for $18! There are four west side locations to choose from.
"The four Dillon's locations couldn't be more different. The first location, which opened in 1999, was once described as "a cute, converted old house that looks like grandma's parlor" by the Phoenix New Times. There, guests devour Kansas City–style barbecue slathered in housemade sauces and listen to live music on Fridays and Saturdays. The combination of good food and relaxed ambiance proved to be so successful that Dillon's opened a second location in Glendale in 2005. This one plays host to golfers and sports enthusiasts, entertaining them with 30 HD-TVs, as well as with live bands on the weekends.
The year 2009 saw Dillon's expanding to Scorpion Bay at Lake Pleasant, where guests can drive their boats or harnessed lochness monsters right up to the restaurant, bar, and general store and sit for a leisurely meal or grab supplies to go. In 2011, Dillon's opened perhaps its most impressive location at the Wild Life World Zoo. Here, guests can dine beside a 60,000 gallon shark tank in the dining room and vibrant pink flamingoes on the patio.
In addition to its unique settings and food, Dillon's is known for its hospitality and sense of fun, including setting up live webcams of its Scorpion Bay and zoo locations. Check them out here andhere. Dillon's particularly likes getting photos of customers enjoying the restaurants on Facebook."
Enjoy!

For the sea-cave kayak tour, tour-goers paddle in formation behind an experienced guide and cruise through La Jolla’s local ecological preserve. What: Free meals offered during opening week, fundraiser held to benefit Amy’s Army, the Non-Profit headed by Amy Van Dyken.

I thought I’d type out a full list of when and where your Pogo Pass is good. I am constantly hearing from readers that the Pogo Pass is their favorite Alicia’s Deal of all time. Venues can change but this is the best value around. I like this so much more than buying a membership to one place, you can enjoy places all over town!
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Head over here to check out Duolingo. It's a great (FREE) website and app that teaches Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, and other languages in an easy format.
"Duolingo is the free science-based language education platform selected by Apple as iPhone App of the Year 2013, by Google as Best of the Best for Android 2013, and by TechCrunch as Best Education Startup.

posts.title: POGO Pass Changes...Now Good at the i.d.e.a. Museum!!!
posts.excerpt: There are some hot things happening with the POGO pass. The great news is that it's now good at the i.d.e.a. museum! You can still head over here to get a pass…
posts.text:
There are some hot things happening with the POGO pass. The great news is that it's now good at the i.d.e.a. museum! You can still head over here to get a pass for $39.98 with promo code ALICIA (that's 60% off!). Our family has passes and it's so much fun to use them!
A message I got from them...
"Pogo Pass Holders will receive 2 free admissions to the i.d.e.a. museum with no restrictions other than it won't be available during opening exhibition weekends, which occur 3 times per year.
*For your information, the AZ Museum of Natural History is no longer on the pass and National Comedy Theatre has changed from 6 visits to 3 visits. We try really hard to offer a variety, but part of our pass is that it is constantly changing (almost always for the better!) the value and variety on the pass is always going to be INCREDIBLE and we hope families understand that!"
My favorite spots are still on the list:
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Regular price to get into Sunsplash is $29.99 so this almost pays for your pass!
Sea Life Aquarium: Each Pass holder can attend Arizona Sea life Aquarium two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front desk to gain admission to the Aquarium. We did this last week and had a blast!
Phoenix Zoo: Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. They have all kinds of fun water stuff around to keep you cool.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is good Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday from 4:30-9.
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season. Check out the select dates here.
Phoenix Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. Pass is valid for twelve (12) months. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Jump Street on Monday and Wednesday. Limited capacity, first come first serve.
And LOTS LOTS more! Rattlers games, Brunswick bowling, Phoenix Rock Gym, Enchanted Island, Comedy Theater, Skateland, and Tempe Paintball are all included! Head over here to see everywhere the pass is taken. Don’t forget to use promo code ALICIA to get your passes for $39.98 each (everyone over two will need their own pass). If you go everywhere it’s worth $1500.
Enjoy!
